payload.description: Lets your Agents think with OpenAI's Codex models, using your ChatGPT account or an OpenAI API key. Connects Leaf to OpenAI's Codex program, so your Agents can use OpenAI's GPT models to chat, write and work on code. It does not come with an account: you sign in with the ChatGPT account that has Codex, or with an OpenAI API key billed by usage. If Codex is missing, Leaf can install it for you.
